title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Pine is an agency building fitness apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Oldmoor.

Our stack: python, go, swift. You will review code with the team, work closely with design and product and build offline-first features.

A yearly learning budget. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
